verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents its own extension formats. Functions are modular Python plugins, and Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters and Pipelines execute arbitrary Python on your own server. Skills are folders containing a SKILL.md file, which Computer picks up automatically, so developers can write and load extensions into a self-hosted instance. Missing for 10: the evidence does not show the actual plugin code structure or skill schema, gives no step-by-step import/upload workflow, and has no independent hands-on corroboration of building and loading a custom plugin.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write my own skill, tool, or plugin against a documented format and load it into my instance locally

citations.quote: Functions are modular Python plugins that extend the capabilities of Open WebUI itself.
Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters, and Pipelines execute arbitrary Python code on your server.
A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file: a reusable instruction set the AI can pull in on demand
if you already keep skills or a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md for another tool, Computer picks them up automatically.
Extend with Python. Share what you build, run what others share.
